questions.question: In Jesus' story, a rich man's manager was accused of wasting his possessions. What did the rich man tell him?

answers.text: Turn in an account because you cannot be manager any longer
Pay back everything you wasted by the end of the week
Take a smaller job until you earn back my trust

questions.question: In Jesus' story, a manager lowered what his master's debtors owed. How did the master respond to him?

answers.text: He commended him for acting shrewdly
He had him thrown into prison
He made him repay the difference

questions.question: After telling the story of the shrewd manager, what did Jesus tell His disciples to use worldly wealth for?

answers.text: To build bigger barns for themselves
To buy more land for themselves
